selection.rule: next ten preserved baseline addresses after accepted Batch 007

decisions.contact_path: Current Inventory Eyes and Safe Writer operate within the bounded PMP repository, while broader repository sizes, languages, binaries, generated files, and unsupported project classes become operational only if Resident or its tools are expanded beyond that proven scope.
decisions.rationale: The supported project class is not yet frozen for future autonomous or generalized operation. Because the current baseline remains the bounded PMP project, this is an active conditional risk rather than a blanket current defect.

decisions.contact_path: Current work-thread, browser storage, public and private Bug Memory, portable packs, Notes handoff, reports, and receipts already distribute user and project data across several locations without one proven complete export and deletion inventory.
decisions.rationale: The data locations exist now. Missing end-to-end export, deletion, retained-evidence explanation, and reopen proof is a current data-lifecycle defect.

decisions.contact_path: Resident authority modes, Safe Writer protected transactions, Code Safety recovery, and tool-aware context already support limited current actions, but there is no single immediate stop that forces all active work into a recoverable HOLD state.
decisions.rationale: Current protected action surfaces already exist. Missing a unified user-controlled emergency stop and recovery receipt is therefore a current operational defect even though broader autonomy is not implemented.

decisions.contact_path: The current workflow already depends in different combinations on local Resident, GitHub Pages, GitHub, Notes, Shortcuts, ZIP libraries, and network access, but no complete capability-tier and simultaneous-outage behavior is proven.
decisions.rationale: Dependency loss can affect current work now. The absence of explicit offline, read-only, unavailable, and recovery states is a current resilience defect.

decisions.contact_path: Current health, truth, X-Ray, inventory, private-memory, workflow, and GitHub-action records already produce diagnostics and logs that may contain paths, context, errors, or private project information without one enforced redaction and retention subsystem.
decisions.rationale: Diagnostic evidence exists now. Missing centralized privacy classification, structured redaction, retention, and secret-canary proof is a current defect.

decisions.contact_path: Resident conversation, health and truth reports, repair requests, and tool-aware guidance already explain technical project state to the user in plain language, but no acceptance standard proves those explanations disclose action, uncertainty, authority, data flow, risk, and rollback accurately.
decisions.rationale: Plain-language explanation is already a current user-facing capability. The absence of completeness and comprehension proof is a current communication defect.

decisions.contact_path: The present project has current Resident and safety tools, while the risk of attempting all planned Safe Change modules at once becomes operational when implementation moves beyond the current planning and limited-action foundation.
decisions.rationale: The first-release boundary is required before broader implementation begins, but the full module set is not yet an active implemented capability. It is an active conditional delivery risk.

decisions.contact_path: The installed iPhone Home Screen baseline and Cache API received evidence on 2026-06-14, while update, offline, cold-cache, changed-version, and wider supported-device conditions remain unproven and activate when those conditions occur.
decisions.rationale: The proven baseline prevents treating the whole installed runtime as a present defect. Remaining platform conditions are credible and live upon update, cache, offline, or support-matrix change, so the risk is active conditional.

decisions.contact_path: The deployed GitHub Pages path was executed for the Packet 03 baseline and no present contradiction is recorded; the limitation reopens when deployment identity, route, content, headers, cache, or behavior changes.
decisions.rationale: The originally missing execution evidence has been supplied for the bounded baseline. The preserved risk is dormant and reopenable rather than a current defect.

decisions.contact_path: The Bug Catalog-to-Notes Shortcut success path is a current verified handoff, but cancel, missing-Shortcut, stale-clipboard, duplicate-run, partial-completion, retry, and receipt behavior remain untested.
decisions.rationale: The external Shortcut handoff is used now. Missing safe failure-state and completion-receipt proof is therefore a current integration defect.

routing_fields_rule: All destination, law, watch-trigger, and semantic-cluster fields remain blank in this batch.
source_preservation_rule: All immutable source fields, addresses, source hashes, original wording, accepted prior classifications, and total envelope count remain unchanged except for the ten selected applicability fields.
